title: AI围城下：Adobe为何选了内部人，12月1日接棒
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There's also breaking news from Adobe, which is a graphics software company that a lot of people are worried will be disrupted by AI.
segments.zh: Adobe也有重大消息，这是一家图形软件公司，很多人担心它会被AI颠覆。

segments.en: It announced a new CEO, Anil Chakravarti, will become president of the year of defective December 1st.
segments.zh: 公司宣布，Anil Chakravarti将于12月1日成为新任CEO。

segments.en: If I remember correctly, it took a while for Adobe to identify its new CEO, didn't it?
segments.zh: 如果我没记错，Adobe花了一段时间才确定新CEO，对吧？

segments.en: It has, and they've been doing this search, and ultimately they've gone with an internal candidate.
segments.zh: 是的，他们一直在进行搜寻，最终选择了内部候选人。

segments.en: So Anil Chakravarti is basically an enterprise veteran.
segments.zh: Anil Chakravarti基本上是一位企业服务领域的资深人士。

segments.en: He's been at Adobe since 2020, and in that six-year period, he has had responsibilities both from the product side and on the go-to-market side.
segments.zh: 他自2020年加入Adobe，在这六年里，他负责过产品端和市场推广端的工作。

segments.en: The shares down in aftermarket, I mean, 2% maybe that's like a modest decline, but he might be better known for his period leading Informatica.
segments.zh: 盘后股价下跌约2%，跌幅不大，但他可能更因领导Informatica的经历而为人所知。

segments.en: He kind of was at Informatica throughout the take-private era where he was focusing on gearing them towards being a cloud company, a subscription company.
segments.zh: 在Informatica私有化期间，他专注于推动公司向云和订阅模式转型。

segments.en: So he's like a known entity out in the world of enterprise, but they've gone internal, and Adobe's broader AI story is difficult, right?
segments.zh: 他在企业界是知名人物，但这次是内部晋升，而Adobe更广泛的AI故事面临挑战，对吧？

segments.en: They've come under pressure from the idea that they're one of these software companies that AI will eat their lunch.
segments.zh: 他们面临压力，因为人们认为AI会侵蚀这类软件公司的业务。
